_comment: Events: messages to a player, shown as the blinking buttons at the bottom of the side panel (right of the computer button). categories: per kind of event its button – slot: top left on the panel image (unscaled, panel space), icons: GUI images of file 03 [dark, lit]; name and text: events.categories.* and events.texts.* in data/lang ({building}: its name). blinkSeconds: how long a button blinks after an event (then it stays lit until looked at); arrowSeconds: how long the arrows point at the place after jumping there (click on the button or space: the latest event); the event's text shows in the panel when looking at it. events: what triggers them – category, cooldownSeconds (per player: at most one such event in that time; 0 = every time), afterSeconds (states of buildings: reported once they lasted this long, once per building until the state ends), enabled.

noStaff._comment: A finished production building waits for its worker and no carrier comes, or a military building stands empty with no soldier on the way.

noTool._comment: A finished production building waits for its worker, whose tool is not in stock.

attacked._comment: One of the player's settlers in the open (soldier, geologist, priest, …) is struck or shot at.

buildingAttacked._comment: The door of one of the player's military buildings or its guard in front of it is struck or shot at.

buildingLost._comment: The enemy took one of the player's military buildings.

buildingCaptured._comment: The player took an enemy military building.

mineExhausted._comment: A mine's chance per run to find ore is maxChance percent or less.

noResources._comment: A gatherer (woodcutter, stonecutter, forester, fisher, waterworks, farm, …) finds nothing to work on in its range.

_datesComment: Messages on certain days (month-day, real date; text: events.dates.<date> in data/lang), at most once a year per entry, while a game runs (remembered in ~/.config/homestead/events-shown.json).
